recipe.title: Recover adjuster visits after a staff availability change
recipe.scenario: An adjuster becomes unavailable after visit windows were agreed. Compare replacement assignments and, where an alternative is confirmed, propose a new window. Preserve fixed visits, bring unresolved conflicts to a dispatcher, and never contact customers or write calendars.

field.name: confirmed-visits
field.description: Opaque visit/task ID, configuration revision, approved UTC appointment window, planned service duration, work role and coarse zone, assigned staff reference, and frozen status.

field.name: staff-changes
field.description: Opaque staff ID and revised UTC blocked or available intervals. Do not include the reason for unavailability.

field.name: replacement-roster
field.description: Staff role and permitted operating zones supplied by a supervisor, UTC windows, fixed commitments, and remaining capacity. The planner does not grant permission to work a case.

field.name: verified-alternates
field.description: Opaque visit IDs and only confirmed alternate time windows. An available alternative is not permission to contact a customer or move a visit.

field.name: travel-and-reserve
field.description: Time matrix between coarse zones, plus minimum transfer and service buffers. Include relevant existing visits, not just those that require recovery.

field.name: recovery-proposals
field.description: For a feasible recovery return old and proposed visit time, proposed approved assignee, and reason. Prefer viable same-time cover before proposing a confirmed alternative.

field.name: unchanged-or-held
field.description: Distinguish confirmed unchanged visits from those on hold for human review. Describe conflicts such as unavailable authorized cover or a frozen visit that cannot be maintained. No cancellations or messages are sent.
